title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: federated Copilot connectors read third-party data in real time
notes: claim 20: fix was 1256 characters, cut to 1200
summary: Hold: the statement that the source system, rather than Microsoft 365, holds the audit trail is not consistent with documented Purview auditing. Microsoft also documents global-service preview automation for publisher and user access settings, unavailable in national clouds; the table incorrectly reports it as undocumented. The uncertainty about connector-specific data protection must be distinguished from documented protections for Copilot conversations.
